column1: # The checks of shell/time-storage.nsh on x86_64 and i686, whose PcatRealTimeClockRuntimeDxe
# (edk2-stable202402 PcRtc.c PcRtcSetWakeupTime) takes an alarm within a day after GetTime(),
# from the day of the alarm that publish-hiidb arms for 23:59:59. See check-shell-log.sh.
# TerminalDxe prints a character outside ASCII as "?" unless the serial terminal is VT-UTF8, so
# the checks of texts that cite "§" compare them with "?" in its place.
# set reads GetWakeupTime() first, changes the time and arms the alarm with SetWakeupTime(TRUE, …)
# a year that a DATE takes but an EFI_TIME does not (UEFI 2.11 §8.3.1): refused before any write

column3: (.error_message | gsub("§"; "?")) == "cannot set question \"Wake-up date\": EFI_TIME 1899-12-31 23:59:58 has Year 1899, outside 1900 to 9999 (UEFI 2.11 ?8.3.1)"

column1: # DateTimeData as publish-hiidb creates it: 2024-02-29 at byte 0, 12:34:56 at byte 4
# the TIME suppresses its second: get shows dashes there, which set takes and keeps

column3: (.error_message | gsub("§"; "?")) == "the second of this TIME is suppressed (UEFI 2.11 ?33.2.5.4.11): give dashes there, which keep it"
